parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host instance ID.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for fuzzy search by project authorization name.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of project authorizations to return per request. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The request token. Leave this parameter empty or set it to an empty string for the first request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description:
The number of entries to skip.
> This parameter takes effect only when NextToken is empty.
